'''Red Wing''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served in the [[Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Republic Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and flew [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. It was one of several units instrumental in bringing the [[Old Sith Wars]] to an end.

==History==
===Battle of Rakata Prime===
Red Wing participated in the successful Republic assault on the [[Star Forge]] in [[3956 BBY]]. When [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Bastila Shan]]&mdash;after having been redeemed by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;shifted the use of her [[Battle meditation/Legends|battle meditation]] to aid the Republic fleet under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Forn Dodonna]], Red Wing was ordered to reinforce the breach in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] fleet's battle formation that had been made by [[Green Squadron (Galactic Republic)|Green Squadron]], opening a hole for the rest of Dodonna's capital ships. This proved the turning point of the [[Battle of Rakata Prime]] that would see the end of the conflict.

===Battle of Telos IV===
In [[3951 BBY]], under the command of Admiral [[Carth Onasi]], Red Wing participated in the [[Battle of Telos IV]], alongside [[Blue Wing (squadron)|Blue Wing]], where it fought against the [[Sith Triumvirate|Sith]] forces of [[Darth Nihilus]].
